item.question: What is the standard quadratic optimization problem (StQP) and why is it significant?
item.answer: The standard quadratic optimization problem (StQP) involves minimizing a quadratic form over the standard simplex, which is a set of linear constraints. It is significant because it represents one of the simplest non-convex objective functions and can model various complex problems, such as portfolio optimization and maximum clique problems. Despite its simplicity, StQP can be NP-hard without specific assumptions on the matrix involved.
